the triple-glazing fixture with laminated glass provided the best overall noise control performance for this hotel's mechanical equipment noise problem.

the triple-pane laminated glass fixture with the highest noise reduction spectrum most closely matched the mechanical equipment noise source spectra, and that the existing window fixture with the lowest noise reduction spectrum most poorly matched the mechanical equipment spectra.
no single window glazing fixture provided adequate noise control for all guest rooms, but that the best overall performance for the hotel was provided by a triple pane laminated glass fixture.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
retrofit sound control glazings are effective in reducing outdoor mechanical noise intrusion, but are not a complete solution.

retrofit glazing can be very effective in reducing noise from mechanical equipment, and that the best choice of window glazing fixture for noise reduction will depend on the tonal characteristics of the noise source.
